name: RunPod on-demand GPU cloud price list
notes: Managed neocloud price list, read 2026-10-03: H100 SXM 80GB $3.49/hr, H100 PCIe 80GB $2.89/hr, H100 NVL 94GB $3.19/hr, RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell 96GB $2.09/hr, A100 PCIe 80GB $1.59/hr. These are the provider's own list rates for managed instances (with CPU/RAM attached), i.e. a list price and a managed-service basis, NOT a per-card market rate. Compare only against VAST peer-to-peer per-GPU-hour, never against card purchase prices.
